# Vendored three.js r160 (MIT)

`three.module.min.js` and `OrbitControls.js` are three.js r160 (Copyright 2010-2023 Three.js Authors,
MIT licence, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js). They are inlined into the offline single-file
builds (`warehouse/tools/build-offline.mjs`) so those files work without internet. The hosted pages
load three.js r170 from the jsDelivr CDN instead.
